readerCopy.headline: The dream gets convincing fast.
readerCopy.body:
An idea that has been floating around may suddenly feel like the answer to a much bigger question. A creative direction can become absorbing. A spiritual practice can feel unusually meaningful. A person or plan may seem to carry more promise because you can see everything it could become.

Jupiter conjunct Neptune expands faith and imagination, but it can also expand assumption. Give the vision a date, budget, boundary, or next step before building your life around it. You do not need to make the dream smaller. Give it enough form to find out what is actually there.
